instruction: Help me fix the issue where the 'MyWork' terminal profile doesn't stay set as default after a reboot.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.write('gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.write('gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.Legacy.Profile:/org/gnome/terminal/legacy/profiles:/:$(gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default | tr -d "'"')/ visible-name'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter')
